'''Suharna Surapranata''' (born 14 December 1955) is an Indonesian physicist and politician from [[Bandung]], [[West Java]]. He served as [[Ministry of Research and Technology#List of Ministers|State Minister for Research and Technology]] in the [[Second United Indonesia Cabinet]] between 2009 and 2011, succeeding [[Kusmayanto Kadiman]], until a reshuffle on 18 October 2011, replaced by Gusti Muhammad Hatta.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.detik.com/berita/1747147/suharna-dicopot-dari-menristek-presiden-pks-hargai-keputusan-sby|title=Suharna Dicopot dari Menristek, Presiden PKS Hargai Keputusan SBY|work=Detik.com|date=October 18, 2011|accessdate=February 1, 2017}}</ref> He is a graduate of the [[Bandung Institute of Technology]] and the [[University of Indonesia]].<ref name="ProfilCalonMenteri">{{cite news|url=http://nasional.kompas.com/read/2009/10/19/11363748/profil.calon.menteri.21|title=Profil Calon Menteri (21)|editor=Abi|work=[[Kompas]]|date=October 19, 2009|accessdate=February 1, 2017}}</ref>

He is co-founder of the [[Prosperous Justice Party]] and served as Chairman of the Central Advisory Council (MPP). He is also co-founder of the Scientists Society of Indonesia (MITI).<ref name="ProfilCalonMenteri"/>
